The '''Deathhammer 17''' was a model of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] that was manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. In about [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[holostar]] [[Javul Charn]] wielded a Deathhammer 17 after falling under attack from the [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Edge (Anomid)|Edge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]].
